name: Splat/Mesh Blending with Transition Smoothing
definition: A hybrid rendering technique that blends point-based splat representations with polygonal mesh representations at their transition boundaries to remove visual discontinuities, using the splat weight sum as a blending factor.
summary: Splat/Mesh Blending with Transition Smoothing is a hybrid rendering technique that eliminates visual discontinuities at boundaries by linearly interpolating between polygonal and splat representations using the splat weight sum as a blending factor.
